# T-3: Revalidate canonical regression snapshots

## Goal
Use the shared factory and value equality at integration gate so fresh evidence passes and substantive Git changes require rerun.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A required artifact passes immediately after save with no worktree change.
- One-byte, add, delete, and rename changes fail stale validation.
- A nested content change under an untracked directory fails stale validation after leaf expansion.
- Ordering-only differences and unchanged deleted entries pass.
- Existing command, classification, config, hook, and artifact side effects remain covered.

## Implementation Notes
Update assertIntegrationRegressionEvidence in test-artifacts.js to parse saved lists and build current lists through RegressionFileSnapshotList; preserve the existing trust decision owner and error routing.

## Test Strategy
Use specs/316-canonical-regression-snapshots/tests/regression-artifact-gate.test.js with `// spec: R2 R3 R4`; run integration-style tests in temporary Git repositories and retain existing targeted/full/skip and gate test coverage.
